Projects Name.value: Enhancing livestock production efficiency through digitalization and precision farming

Comments (Project Description).value: The project aims to leverage digital technology to create a comprehensive database that will inform livestock policy interventions across various value chains. It focuses on enhancing poultry and pig production by providing technical support for informed business decisions, improving efficiency, management, and tracking product movement. Additionally, it seeks to promote and improve dairy production through better farming practices and reduced labor. The project also aims to strengthen institutional capacities within the livestock sector to elevate quality and standards. Lastly, it endeavors to boost fish production to replace imports and penetrate niche export markets.
